Message to Reviewer:

Hi, thank you for your initial feedback and review.
We had capacity for around 100 people at the venue. Nearly all the tables shown in the pictures provided in our Milestone 2 document were part of our venue setup. Since our event had a 3-hour time slot, the space for approximately 100 people turned out to be the perfect size, as we had a constant flow of attendees coming and going. Starting at 11:30, some people came for an early lunch while others chose to join later. This extended timeframe was very important, allowing people to attend regardless of which Token2049 conference talks they wanted to hear or their personal schedules and meetings. We provided a free taco buffet and unlimited soft drinks for all attendees. A representative from MuesliSwap was present to answer questions and give a short presentation about DEXs on Cardano and DeFi in general. Additionally, team members from Linkage facilitated discussions and helped answer questions about the Cardano ecosystem. Moreover we had different Cardano Projects attending, which participated in discussions with other event participants. This was beneficial, as many attendees were not yet very familiar with the Cardano blockchain. However, many of them were eager to build on Cardano, and the event provided the perfect starting point for them to begin their journey and learn more.

ms.report:
Dear Catalyst Review Team,

Thank you very much for your thoughtful feedback on our milestone submission. We truly appreciate your careful review and the opportunity to clarify.
As for attendee feedback, we do not have detailed statistics (number of people who gave feedback, exact citations of what they said, etc.), as interactions took place in a casual environment that encouraged curiosity, making it easier for newcomers to engage. This approach was particularly important for newcomers and non-expert attendees, leading to many valuable and organic discussions where participants learned more about Cardano — especially DeFi opportunities, on-chain metrics, and gaming possibilities.
Would it be helpful if we contacted the MuesliSwap team (who was present for the DEX discussion) to gather additional third-party feedback to provide a clearer picture of the event’s impact?
Thanks for your understanding and support. Please let us know if there are any specific next steps you would recommend.

Best regards,
Marius

The Linkage Finance Team
